title: hubHomeMerge
responsibility: Combines the Home views of several linked computers into one, showing work the Tracker syncs between them once.

inputs.name: mergeHomeSnapshots.snapshots
inputs.description: The validated Home view each online linked computer returned, in any order.

inputs.name: homeBoard.snapshot
inputs.description: The listed owner Home snapshot with its scheduled and past-due runs.

inputs.name: homeBoard.routinesConnected
inputs.description: Whether the routine source is connected and fresh; when false only Tracker runs are kept.

inputs.name: homeBoard.now
inputs.description: The current time in milliseconds that separates upcoming from past due.

outputs.name: mergeHomeSnapshots
outputs.description: One Home view, or null when no computer answered. A single answer is returned unchanged.
